metadata.scope: L-brackets, T-brackets, U-channels, NEMA motor mounts, tube clamps, cantilever brackets.

material_suggestions.use_case: CNC-cut or machined motor mounts and light structural brackets
material_suggestions.notes: Easy to machine; good strength-to-weight; anodise for corrosion protection.
Weld-friendly; finish with primer and paint.

material_suggestions.use_case: 3D-printed motor mounts for robotics and light CNC
material_suggestions.notes: Better stiffness and heat resistance than PLA; use metal inserts for bolt holes.
Good layer adhesion; acceptable up to 70 °C.

standards_used.name: NEMA ICS motor face patterns
standards_used.applies_to: bolt circle, shaft bore, and faceplate dimensions
standards_used.note: NEMA 17: 42.3 mm face, 31 mm bolt circle, 4×M3. NEMA 23: 57.3 mm face, 47.1 mm bolt circle, 4×M5.

standards_used.name: ISO 4762 socket cap screws
standards_used.note: Clearance hole = nominal + 0.5 mm; M3=3.4, M4=4.5, M5=5.5.

standards_used.name: ISO 2768-m general tolerances
standards_used.note: ±0.1 mm on dims <30 mm; ±0.2 on 30–120 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: NEMA 17 motor mount plate
design_rules: shaft_clearance bore must be centered and ≥ 22 mm for NEMA 17 boss
bolt holes on square pattern not circle — place at ±bolt_circle/2 in X and Y
edge margin ≥ 1.5 × bolt_hole_diameter from hole to plate edge
validation_criteria: 4 bolt holes subtracted using for(x=...) for(y=...)
shaft clearance is cylinder not cube
plate is solid cube in union()
failure_modes: single center hole instead of 4-bolt pattern
circular bolt pattern instead of square NEMA pattern
shaft clearance too small to pass motor boss

constraint_checks.message: NEMA mount needs 4 bolts on square pattern.

parts.name: NEMA 23 photo-style L motor mount bracket with slotted base
aliases: stepper motor l bracket with slots
main_features: horizontal base plate with two long rounded mounting slots
vertical NEMA23 motor face plate at 90 degrees
large centered shaft/boss clearance hole through vertical plate
four NEMA23 M5 mounting holes on 47.1 mm square spacing
two triangular side gussets between base and upright
chamfered top/outside corners on vertical face plate like the photo
design_rules: Model as an L bracket: base plate in XY with Z thickness; motor face plate in YZ with X thickness.
NEMA23 holes are a square pattern at +/-47.1/2 in Y and Z around the face center, not a circular bolt pattern.
Motor face holes and central shaft clearance pass through X using rotate([0,90,0]) cylinders.
Base slots pass through Z and must be rounded slots using hull() between two cylinders.
Side gussets are triangular prisms in XZ extruded through a small Y thickness; do not use full-width or vertical Z extrusions.
Photo-style vertical plate has chamfered top/outside corners; use a 2D polygon face extruded through plate thickness.
validation_criteria: central shaft clearance cylinder through vertical face
four NEMA23 holes use nested y/z loops or equivalent 2x2 pattern
base slots use hull() between cylinders
face plate has chamfered polygon or equivalent clipped top corners
failure_modes: plain flat NEMA plate instead of L bracket with base
circular bolt pattern for NEMA23 instead of square 47.1 mm spacing
round base holes instead of long rounded slots
central shaft clearance missing or too small
gussets extruded along Z or across the full bracket width
vertical holes not rotated through X

parts.name: Plain equal-leg L-bracket

edge_margin.note: keeps holes away from plate edges

optional_gusset_run.note: only add if user asks for gusset, rib, reinforced, heavy-duty, or load-bearing bracket

main_features: plain base plate in XY with thickness along Z
plain upright plate in YZ with thickness along X at one base edge
four base holes through Z in a 2x2 pattern
four upright holes through X in a 2x2 pattern
design_rules: Default L-bracket is plain: two perpendicular plates and mounting holes only.
Only add gussets/ribs when the prompt explicitly asks for gusset, rib, reinforced, heavy-duty, load-bearing, or shelf support.
Use one global difference(): union() contains both plates; all holes are subtractive.
Base plate coordinates: cube([leg_a_length, bracket_width, plate_thickness]) translated to z=plate_thickness/2.
Upright plate coordinates: cube([plate_thickness, bracket_width, leg_b_length]) translated to x=-leg_a_length/2+plate_thickness/2 and z=leg_b_length/2.
Base holes pass through Z using unrotated cylinders at z=plate_thickness/2.
Upright holes pass through X using rotate([0,90,0]) cylinders at x=-leg_a_length/2+plate_thickness/2.
Never use negative Z positions for upright holes; z positions must be edge_margin and leg_b_length-edge_margin.
If a gusset/rib is explicitly requested, it must be a triangular prism, not a flat rectangular block on the base.
For two requested side gussets, make two thin triangular prisms near y=+/-bracket_width/2, not two full-width overlapping extrusions.
For rounded corners, use a 2D rounded rectangle with linear_extrude; avoid 3D minkowski that doubles plate thickness.
validation_criteria: plain L-bracket contains two perpendicular plates without gussets unless requested
base plate and upright plate use different thickness axes
upright holes include rotate([0,90,0]) before cylinder
upright hole z positions are within 0..leg_b_length
base holes use nested x/y loops for a 2x2 pattern when four holes are requested
if gusset is requested, triangular gusset uses polygon(...) plus linear_extrude(...) or equivalent polyhedron
failure_modes: adding gussets to a plain L-bracket prompt that did not request reinforcement
vertical plate holes use unrotated Z-axis cylinders
vertical hole loop uses [-leg_length/2 + edge_margin, leg_length/2 - edge_margin]
requested gusset is a rectangular block instead of triangular web
linear_extrude(height=bracket_width) is duplicated for front/back gussets and creates overlapping full-width webs
rounded_plate uses 3D minkowski and doubles the plate thickness
vertical plate is rotated/translated from a horizontal plate instead of explicitly modeled as YZ plate
holes use plate_length for Y positions and fall outside bracket_width

constraint_checks.expression: two cube() calls in union present
